decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions, because of their design, appearance and relative position to adjoining properties, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the street scene, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the objectives of the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 64 Spring Grove Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall or roof slope of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and roof extension to house.
